source.title: A Task Analysis of Pier Side Ship-Handling for Virtual Environment Ship-Handling Simulator Scenario Development
source.author: Charles R. Grassi, Lieutenant USN
source.type: M.S. thesis, Naval Postgraduate School, September 2000

source_bounded_contribution: The thesis develops GOMS-like models and Critical Cue Inventories for two generic/simple pier-side simulator evolutions, then amends them through CDM interviews with five qualified SWOs. It does not prove universal expert cognition, cue independence, or operational sufficiency.
active_scope: Historical simulator-analysis method only; any other simulator or agent application is a constructed adaptation with its own evidence and review.
